newsitem.title: USA: Brilliant Digital sees losses in Q1, Q2.
newsitem.headline: Brilliant Digital sees losses in Q1, Q2.

text.p: Brilliant Digital Entertainment Inc said Friday it expects to continue reporting net losses through the first and second quarters of 1997.
In a statement it blamed "substantial operating expenses and development costs."
Brilliant Digital also said that "depending upon the level of revenues, the company may continue to incure losses for the remainder of the fiscal year."
The company today a loss of $0.24 a share for the fourth quarter, ended December 31, compared to a profit of $0.15 a year earlier.
